name: Will spray foam insulation help with noise reduction in my home?

mainEntity.name: Will spray foam insulation help with noise reduction in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, spray foam insulation can significantly help with noise reduction. Both open-cell and closed-cell spray foams create an effective air seal, which is crucial for blocking sound transmission. Open-cell foam, in particular, has a softer, more absorbent texture that can be very effective at dampening airborne sounds, making it a good choice for interior walls or between floors. By filling all gaps and voids, spray foam reduces flanking paths for sound, contributing to a quieter and more peaceful indoor environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, spray foam insulation helps with noise reduction by creating an airtight seal and dampening sound transmission, especially open-cell foam which absorbs airborne noise.
